fields.name: dwSize
fields.description: The total size of the returned structure in bytes (that is, not usually the size of the SIMCONNECT_RECV structure, but of the structure that inherits it).

fields.name: dwVersion
fields.description: The version number of the SimConnect server.

fields.name: dwID
fields.description: The ID of the returned structure. One member of SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID.

fields.name: szApplicationName[256]
fields.description: Null-terminated string containing the application name.

fields.name: dwApplicationVersionMajor
fields.description: Double word containing the application version major number.

fields.name: dwApplicationVersionMinor
fields.description: Double word containing the application version minor number.

fields.name: dwApplicationBuildMajor
fields.description: Double word containing the application build major number.

fields.name: dwApplicationBuildMinor
fields.description: Double word containing the application build minor number.

fields.name: dwSimConnectVersionMajor
fields.description: Double word containing the SimConnect version major number.

fields.name: dwSimConnectVersionMinor
fields.description: Double word containing the SimConnect version minor number.

fields.name: dwSimConnectBuildMajor
fields.description: Double word containing the SimConnect build major number.

fields.name: dwSimConnectBuildMinor
fields.description: Double word containing the SimConnect build minor number.

fields.name: dwReserved1
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: dwReserved2
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: dwException
fields.description: One member of the SIMCONNECT_EXCEPTION enumeration type, indicating which error has occurred.

fields.name: dwSendID
fields.description: The ID of the packet that contained the error, see Remarks below.

fields.name: dwIndex
fields.description: The index number (starting at 1) of the first parameter that caused an error. Special case: UNKNOWN_INDEX = 0.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined request.

fields.name: dwObjectID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined object.

fields.name: dwDefineID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined data definition.

fields.name: dwFlags
fields.description: The flags that were set for this data request, see SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject for a description of the flags. This parameter will always be set to zero if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwentrynumber
fields.description: If multiple objects are being returned, this is the index number of this object out of a total of dwoutof. This will always be 1 if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject, and can be 0 or more if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwoutof
fields.description: The total number of objects being returned. Note that dwentrynumber and dwoutof start with 1 not 0, so if two objects are being returned dwentrynumber and dwoutof pairs will be 1,2 and 2,2 for the two objects. This will always be 1 if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject, and can be 0 or more if the call was SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObjectType.

fields.name: dwDefineCount
fields.description: The number of 8-byte elements in the dwData array.

fields.name: dwData
fields.description: A data array containing information on a specified object in 8-byte (double word) elements. The length of the array is dwDefineCount.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwObjectID
fields.description: Double word containing the server defined object ID.

fields.name: uGroupID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined group, or the special case value: UNKNOWN_GROUP (which equals DWORD_MAX).

fields.name: uEventID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined event that has been requested (such as EVENT_1 or EVENT_BRAKES).

fields.name: dwData
fields.description: This value is usually zero, but some events require further qualification. For example, joystick movement events require a movement value in addition to the notification that the joystick has been moved (see SimConnect_MapInputEventToClientEvent for more information).

fields.name: szFileName[MAX_PATH]
fields.description: The returned filename.

fields.name: dwFlags
fields.description: Reserved, should be 0.

fields.name: fFrameRate
fields.description: The visual frame rate in frames per second.

fields.name: fSimSpeed
fields.description: The simulation rate. For example if the simulation is running at four times normal speed - 4X - then 4.0 will be returned.

fields.name: eObjType
fields.description: Specifies the type of object that was added or removed. One member of the SIMCONNECT_SIMOBJECT_TYPE enumeration.

fields.name: dwRacerNumber
fields.description: The index of the racer the results are for. Players are indexed from 0.

fields.name: RacerData
fields.description: A SIMCONNECT_DATA_RACE_RESULT structure.

fields.name: dwLapIndex
fields.description: The index of the lap the results are for. Laps are indexed from 0.

fields.name: RacerData
fields.description: A SIMCONNECT_DATA_RACE_RESULT structure.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwInteger
fields.description: Double word containing an integer, or boolean, value.

fields.name: fFloat
fields.description: A float value.

fields.name: szString
fields.description: Null-terminated string.

fields.name: szChoiceReserved[30]
fields.description: Null-terminated string containing the key that has been reserved. This will be identical to the string entered as one of the choices for the SimConnect_RequestReservedKey function.

fields.name: szReservedKey[50]
fields.description: Null-terminated string containing the reserved key combination. This will be an uppercase string containing all the modifiers that apply. For example, if the client program requests "q", and the choice is accepted, then this parameter will contain "TAB+Q". If the client program requests "Q", then this parameter will contain "SHIFT+TAB+Q". This string could then appear, for example, in a dialog from the client application, informing a user of the appropriate help key.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwArraySize
fields.description: Double word containing the number of elements in the list that are within this packet. For example, if there are 25 airports returned in the SIMCONNECT_RECV_AIRPORT_LIST structure, then this field will contain 25, but if there are 400 airports in the list and the data is returned in two packets, then this value will contain the number of entries within each packet.

fields.name: dwEntryNumber
fields.description: Double word containing the index number of this list packet. This number will be from 0 to dwOutOf - 1.

fields.name: dwOutOf
fields.description: Double word containing the total number of packets used to transmit the list.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_DATA_FACILITY_AIRPORT structures.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_DATA_FACILITY_NDB structures.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwInteger
fields.description: Double word containing an integer, or boolean, value.

fields.name: fFloat
fields.description: A float value.

fields.name: szString
fields.description: Null-terminated string.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_DATA_FACILITY_WAYPOINT structures.

fields.name: dwRequestID
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: dwArraySize
fields.description: Double word containing the number of elements in the list that are within this packet. For example, if there are items returned in the structure, then this field will contain 25, but if there are 400 items in the list and the data is returned in two packets, then this value will contain the number of entries within each packet, ie: 200.

fields.name: dwREntry
fields.description: Double word containing the index number of this list packet. This number will be from 0 to dwOutOf - 1.

fields.name: dwOutOf
fields.description: Double word containing the total number of packets used to transmit the list.

fields.name: UserRequestId
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: UniqueRequestId
fields.description: The unique request ID, so the client can identify it.

fields.name: ParentUniqueRequestId
fields.description: If the current message is about a child object, this field will contain the parent's UniqueRequestId, otherwise it will be 0.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Specifies the type of the object, will be a value from the SIMCONNECT_FACILITY_DATA_TYPE enum.

fields.name: IsListItem
fields.description: If the current message is about a child object, this specifies if it is an orphan object or not.

fields.name: ItemIndex
fields.description: If IsListItem is true then this specifies the index in the list.

fields.name: ListSize
fields.description: If IsListItem is true, then this specifies the list size.

fields.name: Data
fields.description: Buffer of data. Have to cast it to a struct which matches the definition.

fields.name: RequestId
fields.description: Double word containing the client defined request ID.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_FACILITY_MINIMAL structures.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_JETWAY_DATA structures.

fields.name: ident
fields.description: The airport ICAO code.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The airport region code.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the airport facility.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the airport facility.

fields.name: Altitude
fields.description: Altitude of the facility in meters.

fields.name: fFrequency
fields.description: Frequency of the station in Hz.

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: Flags indicating whether the other fields are valid or not. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_NAV_SIGNAL(0x1): Set if the station has a NAV transmitter, and if so, GlideLat, GlideLon and GlideAlt contain valid data. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_LOCALIZER(0x2): Set if the station transmits an ILS localizer angle, and if so fLocalizer contains valid data. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_GLIDE_SLOPE(0x4): Set if the station transmits an ILS approach angle, and if so fGlideSlopeAngle contains valid data. SIMCONNECT_RECV_ID_VOR_LIST_HAS_DME(0x8): Set if the station t transmits a DME signal, and if so the inherited DME fFrequency contains valid data.

fields.name: fLocalizer
fields.description: The ILS localizer angle in degrees.

fields.name: GlideLat
fields.description: The latitude of the glide slope transmitter in degrees.

fields.name: GlideLon
fields.description: The longitude of the glide slope transmitter in degrees.

fields.name: GlideAlt
fields.description: The altitude of the glide slope transmitter in degrees.

fields.name: fGlideSlopeAngle
fields.description: The ILS approach angle in degrees.

fields.name: fMagVar
fields.description: The magnetic variation of the waypoint in degrees.

fields.name: icao
fields.description: The SIMCONNECT_ICAO struct with information about the facility.

fields.name: lla
fields.description: The latitude, longitude and altitude of the facility, returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_LATLONALT struct.

fields.name: Ident
fields.description: The identity string.

fields.name: Region
fields.description: The region string.

fields.name: Airport
fields.description: The airport string.

fields.name: AirportIcao
fields.description: ICAO code of the airport (will be the same as the one you used to make the request).

fields.name: ParkingIndex
fields.description: Index of the parking space linked to this jetway (will be the same as the one you used to make the request).

fields.name: Lla
fields.description: Lattitude / Longitude / Altitude of the jetway, returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_LATLONALT struct.

fields.name: Pbh
fields.description: Pitch / Bank / Heading of the jetway, returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_PBH struct.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: The status of the jetway, which will be one of the following: 0: JETWAY_STATUS_REST 1: JETWAY_STATUS_APPROACH_OUTSIDE 2: JETWAY_STATUS_APPROACH_DOOR 3: JETWAY_STATUS_HOOD_CONNECT 4: JETWAY_STATUS_HOOD_DISCONNECT 5: JETWAY_STATUS_RETRACT_OUTSIDE 6: JETWAY_STATUS_RETRACT_HOME 7: JETWAY_STATUS_FULLY_ATTACHED

fields.name: Door
fields.description: The index of the door attached to the jetway.

fields.name: ExitDoorRelativePos
fields.description: Door position relative to aircraft, returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_XYZ struct.

fields.name: MainHandlePos
fields.description: Relative position of IK_MainHandle (world pos, in meters), returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_XYZ struct.

fields.name: SecondaryHandle
fields.description: Relative position of IK_SecondaryHandle (world pos, in meters), returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_XYZ struct.

fields.name: WheelGroundLock
fields.description: Relative position of IK_WheelsGroundLock (world pos, in meters), returned as a SIMCONNECT_DATA_XYZ struct

fields.name: JetwayObjectId
fields.description: ObjectId of the jetway (used by SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject for example)

fields.name: AttachedObjectId
fields.description: ObjectId of the object (aircraft) attached to the jetway (used by SimConnect_RequestDataOnSimObject for example)

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude in degrees.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude in degrees.

fields.name: Altitude
fields.description: Altitude in feet.

fields.name: Pitch
fields.description: Pitch in degrees.

fields.name: Bank
fields.description: Bank in degrees.

fields.name: Heading
fields.description: Heading in degrees.

fields.name: OnGround
fields.description: Set this to 1 to place the object on the ground, or 0 if the object is to be airborne.

fields.name: Airspeed
fields.description: The airspeed in knots, or one of the following special values: INITPOSITION_AIRSPEED_CRUISE (-1): The aircraft's design cruising speed. INITPOSITION_AIRSPEED_KEEP (-2): Maintain the current airspeed.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude in degrees.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude in degrees.

fields.name: Altitude
fields.description: Altitude in feet.

fields.name: Pitch
fields.description: The pitch in degrees.

fields.name: Bank
fields.description: The bank in degrees.

fields.name: Heading
fields.description: The heading in degrees.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The position along the x axis.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The position along the y axis.

fields.name: z
fields.description: The position along the z axis.

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude in degrees.

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude in degrees.

fields.name: Altitude
fields.description: Altitude in feet.

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: Specifies the flags set for this waypoint, see SIMCONNECT_WAYPOINT_FLAGS. These flags can be OR'ed together, for example: Flags = SIMCONNECT_WAYPOINT_ON_GROUND | SIMCONNECT_WAYPOINT_REVERSE;

fields.name: ktsSpeed
fields.description: Specifies the required speed in knots. If a specific speed is required, then the SIMCONNECT_WAYPOINT_SPEED_REQUESTED flag must be set to True.

fields.name: percentThrottle
fields.description: Specifies the required throttle as a percentage. If a specific throttle percentage is required, then the SIMCONNECT_WAYPOINT_THROTTLE_REQUESTED flag must be set to True.

fields.name: szMarkerName[64]
fields.description: Null-terminated string containing the marker name. One from the following list: Cg ModelCenter Wheel Skid Ski Float Scrape Engine Prop Eyepoint LongScale LatScale VertScale AeroCenter WingApex RefChord Datum WingTip FuelTank Forces

fields.name: dwMarkerState
fields.description: Double word containing the marker state, set to 1 for on and 0 for off.

fields.name: dwNumberOfRacers
fields.description: The total number of racers.

fields.name: MissionGUID
fields.description: The GUID of the mission that has been selected by the host.

fields.name: szPlayerName[MAX_PATH]
fields.description: Null terminated string containing the name of the player.

fields.name: szSessionType[MAX_PATH]
fields.description: Null terminated string containing the type of the multiplayer session, currently one of: "LAN" or "GAMESPY".

fields.name: szAircraft[MAX_PATH]
fields.description: Null terminated string containing the aircraft type.

fields.name: szPlayerRole[MAX_PATH]
fields.description: Null terminated string containing the player's role (or name) in the mission. This string wil be filled from the Name property of the Player object in the mission file.

fields.name: fTotalTime
fields.description: If this structure is a member of a SIMCONNECT_RECV_EVENT_RACE_END structure, then this contains the final race time in seconds, or 0 for DNF (Did Not Finish). If this structure is a member of a SIMCONNECT_RECV_EVENT_RACE_LAP structure, then this contains the lap time in seconds.

fields.name: fPenaltyTime
fields.description: If this structure is a member of a SIMCONNECT_RECV_EVENT_RACE_END structure, then this contains the final penalty time in seconds. If this structure is a member of a SIMCONNECT_RECV_EVENT_RACE_LAP structure, then this contains the total penalty time in seconds received so far (not just for this lap).

fields.name: dwIsDisqualified
fields.description: A boolean value, 0 indicating the player has not been disqualified, non-zero indicating they have been disqualified.

fields.name: Major
fields.description: The major version number.

fields.name: Minor
fields.description: The minor version number.

fields.name: Revision
fields.description: The revision number.

fields.name: Build
fields.description: The build ID.

fields.name: uGroupID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined group, or the special case value: UNKNOWN_GROUP (which equals DWORD_MAX).

fields.name: uEventID
fields.description: The ID of the client defined event that has been requested (such as EVENT_1 or EVENT_BRAKES).

fields.name: dwData to dwData
fields.description: Each of these 5 paramters corresponds to a parameter that was passed along with the event.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_INPUT_EVENT_DESCRIPTOR structures.

fields.name: Hash
fields.description: Hash ID that identifies the input event.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: String that contains the values, separated by ;. Values can be: char[260] FLOAT64

fields.name: RequestID
fields.description: Specifies the client defined request ID.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: One member of the SIMCONNECT_INPUT_EVENT_TYPE enumeration type. This is used to cast the Value to the correct type.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The value of the requested input event, which should be cast to the correct format (float / string).

fields.name: Hash
fields.description: Hash ID that will identify the subscribed input event.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: One member of the SIMCONNECT_INPUT_EVENT_TYPE enumeration type. This is used to cast the Value to the correct type.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The value of the subscribed input event, which should be cast to the correct format (float / string).

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_CONTROLLER_ITEM structures.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the Input Event.

fields.name: Hash
fields.description: The hash ID for the event.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: The expected datatype (from the SIMCONNECT_DATATYPE enum). Usually a FLOAT32 or STRING128.

fields.name: NodeNames
fields.description: A list of the names of the nodes linked to this InputEvent, where each node name is separated by a ;.

fields.name: DeviceName
fields.description: A string that gives the descriptive name for the device.

fields.name: DeviceId
fields.description: The device ID.

fields.name: ProductId
fields.description: The product ID.

fields.name: CompositeID
fields.description: ID of the USB composite device (for when devices have the same ProductId, but there are multiple recognised parts on the same device)

fields.name: HardwareVersion
fields.description: The version data for the hardware, returned as a SIMCONNECT_VERSION_BASE_TYPE struct.

fields.name: AircraftTitle
fields.description: A string that gives the container title of a SimObject, as found in the title parameter of the aircraft.cfg file.

fields.name: LiveryName
fields.description: A string that gives the name of a livery, as defined in the name parameter of the livery.cfg file.

fields.name: rgData[dwArraySize]
fields.description: Array of SIMCONNECT_ENUMERATE_SIMOBJECT_LIVERY structures.
